sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r11/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (openpyxl read_only, in memory; sheet 'Quality Checks' row 13 = check 12; sheet 'Internal Quality Checks' row 13 annotation; sha256 6d44970b...7fd7f)
evidence: Workbook 'Quality Checks' row 12: "[environment].docker_image isn't set while the agent Dockerfile still has active build steps (which would skip the Dockerfile entirely)." Internal sheet carries the same wording, no extra annotation. Frozen task/task.toml:20-24 [environment] contains only build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096; tomllib parse confirms environment keys = {build_timeout_sec, network_mode, cpus, memory_mb} and [verifier.environment] = {network_mode: public}. grep -rn docker_image over the entire frozen task tree returned no match, so no prebuilt image is configured anywhere. task/environment/Dockerfile has active build steps (FROM node:22-bookworm-slim; RUN apt-get install ca-certificates git procps sqlite3; RUN npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1; COPY instructions/ /instructions/; COPY assets/ /assets/; RUN chmod/git init /app), so those steps are live and will run because nothing shadows them. Frozen task.toml [agent]/[environment]/[verifier] tables are identical to the template task.toml:17-38; environment/Dockerfile sha256 0a75419e...67d1 equals the template's Dockerfile hash in manifest.json, and task.toml sha256 ac664d0e...8f26 matches manifest. Counterexample attempts: (a) broken config that could pass — a docker_image pointing at a stale prebuilt image lacking /assets or better-sqlite3 would silently skip the COPY/npm steps; not present here. (b) conforming alternative that could fail — none: the row is purely a config-absence check and the agent Dockerfile builds from a public pinned base under network_mode public. This is a static configuration check; no runtime measurement is required for it. It says nothing about build success, Oracle, model or portal scores.
